descriptions.shortDescription: One shared external portal for clients and suppliers
descriptions.longDescription:
Portaliq is the shared external portal of the Conduction app suite.
Clients (citizens) and suppliers (companies) get one integrated,
white-label portal to see and act on their records across every app.
Portaliq reads the data through OpenRegister and renders the portal
contribution of each app. It owns the external login (DigiD,
eHerkenning, eIDAS), the white-label portal shell, the unified inbox
and the register of portal contributions. Employees keep working in
the internal apps.
Conduction maintains this component within the Nextcloud ISV programme.
Install it from the Nextcloud App Store at
https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/portaliq.
features: External login with DigiD, eHerkenning and eIDAS
White-label portal shell with its own domain and theme
Unified inbox for clients and suppliers
Portal contributions from every app in the suite
Data read and written through OpenRegister

descriptions.shortDescription: Eén gedeeld extern portaal voor klanten en leveranciers
descriptions.longDescription:
Portaliq is het gedeelde externe portaal van de Conduction-appsuite.
Klanten (burgers) en leveranciers (bedrijven) krijgen één
geïntegreerd, white-label portaal waarin ze hun gegevens uit alle apps
inzien en er acties op uitvoeren. Portaliq haalt de gegevens op via
OpenRegister en toont de portaalbijdrage van elke app. Portaliq
verzorgt de externe inlog (DigiD, eHerkenning, eIDAS), de white-label
portaalschil, de gebundelde berichtenbox en het register van
portaalbijdragen. Medewerkers blijven werken in de interne apps.
Conduction onderhoudt dit component binnen het Nextcloud ISV-programma.
Installeer het via de Nextcloud App Store op
https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/portaliq.
features: Externe inlog met DigiD, eHerkenning en eIDAS
White-label portaalschil met een eigen domein en thema
Gebundelde berichtenbox voor klanten en leveranciers
Portaalbijdragen van elke app in de suite
Gegevens lezen en schrijven via OpenRegister

sources.caveat: Authors of the latest 1000 commits of the last 12 months, told apart by address after the repository's .mailmap. Their organisation is the domain of their address, or for a personal, hidden or noreply address the company on their public profile. results.title: Project health (CHAOSS)
results.description: How active and widely carried the project is: the bus factor, the spread over organisations, how change requests and issues are handled, and how often it releases. Informative: shown, not rated.
results.message: 6 of 6 CHAOSS metrics measured. They are shown for information and do not count in any rating.

metrics.name: Contributor Absence Factor
metrics.explanation: The fewest people who together made half of the commits on the default branch in the last 12 months, of the 100 contributors GitHub reports, among 6 human contributors. At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (300 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. The largest is conduction.nl (2 authors), with 83% of the 300 commits whose organisation is known; 0% of the commits come from 0 of 4 authors whose organisation stays unknown. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.

metrics.name: Change Request Closure Ratio
metrics.explanation: 1,939 change requests were closed (merged or not) and 2,042 opened in the last 90 days, bots included. Below 1 the open backlog grows; above 1 it shrinks.

metrics.name: Time to First Response
metrics.explanation: None of the 15 latest change requests opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13 got a comment or review from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Issue Response Time
metrics.explanation: None of the 9 latest issues opened by people between 2026-08-22 and 2026-11-13 got a comment from anyone but its author.

metrics.name: Release Frequency
metrics.explanation: 8 final releases were published in the last 12 months, about one every 46 days, counted from the GitHub releases. The latest final release is from 2026-10-08. Besides these, 579 pre-releases were published; they are not counted. Drafts and pre-releases are left out.
